selection_algorithm: Within each declared lexical/NER stratum, sort SHA256(seed + NUL + normalized source document ID); take 48 glossary-substring-screen sentences and 12 NER-organization/no-glossary-substring controls; sort union by same key. No resolver or LLM result is used.
target_selection: Longest literal glossary surface, lexicographic tie, first occurrence; extend manually to actual continuous whole expression when it denotes a different role/unit/artifact/nonmention. NER controls: first source OGG span. Freeze target-only packet before independent AI review.
limitations: Lexical/NER-stratified sample, not a random deployment audit.
Disjointness is checked against available local prior annotation/data/request/report files, not LLM pretraining or unavailable historical corpora.
KONEC source sentences overlap KLUE; this is not an independent second corpus.
Upstream article/document IDs are unavailable; sentence-level IDs are preserved and article-level independence cannot be claimed.
Linking/semantics labels are AI-authored, independently AI reviewed and adjudicated; original NER spans/types are upstream labels.
Only 60 primary targets are task-scored; 138 primary+secondary annotations do not constitute exhaustive entity-linking gold.
The historical organization glossary is reused byte-for-byte; its organization/place/channel boundaries require stated adjudication.
Source sentences may be familiar to pretrained LLMs; this is not a pretraining contamination test.
Domestic administrative-unit geographic uses follow an explicitly adjudicated glossary convention; this does not establish a universal organization/territory identity policy.
administrative_unit_scope: For this frozen glossary only, domestic LOCAL descriptions denote named administrative units including territorial uses; ORG_ prefixes alone do not impose organization/seat-only semantics. Domestic weather/address references LINK; DPRK Gangwon is a different unit and remains NIL.
